'''Parv Dijj''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] professor of [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|Xenoarchaeology]] at the [[University of Ketaris]]. Parv Dijj was the wife of [[Groob]] and had a daughter named [[Ulsee]].<ref name="TCWSM2" />
